name: philosophy
tier_note: Tiers = CONCEPTUAL difficulty, NOT obscurity (T1 lived/concrete situations a kid has been in .. T5 sophisticated disputes between real positions); grade-10 ceiling. Aim ~30%+ of rungs at T1-T2. No -isms/-ologies in T1-T2 stems. Operative gameplay gate = TOTAL record chars (stem + 4 choices): T1<=660, T2<=770, T3<=930, T4<=1100, T5<=1200; context is uncapped (it is read only AFTER the answer, off the timer).
voice_rule: PHILOSOPHY = REASONING MOVES + WONDER, never name-recall trivia. TWO shapes both welcome: (A) STORY/DRAMA -- a thinker's life/deed/death told as a vivid scene; the NAMED subject LEADS the stem (names ARE allowed in this shape); the answer is the most memorable specific MOVE or cool fact (Socrates drinking the hemlock he could have fled; Diogenes telling Alexander to stop blocking his sun; Goedel wrecking Russell & Whitehead's ten-year project in a single 1931 paper). (B) MOVE/SCENARIO -- a concrete scene embodies a reasoning move, fallacy, or dilemma; the four choices are competing POSITIONS or MOVES in PLAIN language (NEVER -ism labels, Greek/German terms, or jargon a kid must decode); the answer is the move that survives scrutiny. HARD BANS: bare 'X said Y -> name the doctrine' attribution; 'what does <term> mean' definition-recall; choices that require knowing technical vocabulary. CONTESTED metaphysics/ethics (identity, free will, mind-body, beauty, justice): impose NO verdict -- put the disputed claim in a CHARACTER's mouth WITH a forcing constraint in the scene, make the four choices competing schools, and key the one whose reasoning MATCHES what the character said (a competent philosopher holding the opposite view must NOT be markable wrong). For a FALLACY / negative-flag rung the answer is the SUBSTANTIVE COLLAPSE spelled out -- the real distinction the soundbite blurs (e.g. act vs omission for 'silence is violence') -- NOT the fallacy's NAME (the label goes to context). Every distractor is a real rival position or a real misunderstanding a smart person could hold -- no throwaways, tight length-parity. SPINE: the classical moral traditions are the HEART -- Greeks (Socrates, Plato, Aristotle), the Stoics (Marcus Aurelius, Epictetus, Seneca), the Cynics and Epicureans, Confucius and the Chinese tradition, Rome, the Renaissance and Enlightenment, and the modern individualist tradition (Ayn Rand / Objectivism presented as a REAL position, never strawmanned, never in a smug-good-guy voice). A kid should meet Marcus Aurelius, Confucius, and Aristotle far more often than any qualia puzzle.
framing: Apply each topic's framing_note (moral_vision stance + the named-thinker exemplars). Classical-liberal / traditionalist on political philosophy; care ethics is DEFINED then SCRUTINIZED from real angles (not endorsed, not strawmanned); the negative-vs-positive-rights distinction is taught (no natural entitlement to another's labor; charity is a high virtue; relational duties bind the giver but are not the receiver's right); parental and local partiality is JUST; equity-feminism (Sommers) over gender-feminism; Hayek / Bastiat / Sowell / Smith / public-choice are the substantive critique tradition (recognize the move, no verdict declared). The pedagogical METHOD stays neutral -- the player recognizes the reasoning move; the answer never sneers or declares a policy right/wrong. CONTENT selection is substantive, METHOD is neutral. Never WARP a topic to force a principle in -- if it doesn't fit naturally, drop it. STANCE vs NEUTRAL (CRITICAL -- the no-verdict rule is NOT uniform): stay strictly NEUTRAL on genuinely OPEN disputes (free will, personal identity, mind-body, beauty/taste, the existence of God + the problem of evil, distributive justice such as Rawls-vs-Nozick, the trolley). BUT moral_vision's settled commitments (sections 1, 3, 9) name questions where the bank is committed and must LEAN -- while still steel-manning the other side, never strawmanning, never sneering. The bank is a MORAL REALIST: real good and evil exist. So on moral / cultural relativism and moral nihilism ('there are no objective values'), STEEL-MAN relativism (attributed: Protagoras, Mackie, Harman -- kids must know what it is) but KEY the refutations -- the REFORMER'S DILEMMA (relativism brands the abolitionists / MLK definitionally WRONG and makes moral progress impossible), the self-refutation, the Moorean 'torturing a child for fun is just wrong' -- and NEVER reward a kid for selecting 'whatever a society approves is right' / 'there are no objective values', nor mark moral realism wrong. The bank LEANS the same way (steel-man, then answer) on: communism's ~65-100M death toll and the economic calculation problem (established record; Marx steel-manned as PHILOSOPHY, the body count stated plainly); human sex is biologically binary; NO anti-Western / anti-white inherent-condemnation presented as fact; NO positive 'right' to a good or service keyed as a natural or unalienable right; a postmodern / critical-theory frame (biopower, deconstruction, 'grand narratives are oppression') is the THINKER'S CLAIM, never adopted as neutral fact.
